species: C57BL/6 mouse (in vivo); primary rat microglia/astrocyte cultures and BV2/CTX-TNA2/Neuro-2A cell lines (in vitro)
condition_other: intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) induced by intrastriatal collagenase injection
readout_other: modified neurological severity score (mNSS); cresyl violet staining (injury volume, hemispheric enlargement); brain water content; hemoglobin assay; Fluoro-Jade B staining; T2-weighted MRI (lesion volume); Western blot (Iba1, GFAP, BDNF, VEGF, COX-2, p65/p-p65, Akt/p-Akt, cleaved caspase-3); ELISA (IL-1β, IL-6, MIP-2); MTT cell viability; Griess nitrite assay
direction_notes: LIPUS decreased microglial and astrocyte activation and reduced pro-inflammatory cytokine (IL-1β, IL-6, MIP-2) and PAR4-PI3K/Akt-NF-κB signalling after ICH/thrombin induction, while increasing BDNF and reducing neuronal/myelin damage and neurological deficits.

exposures.label: LIPUS to striatal ICH lesion (in vivo mouse)

target.label: striatum (collagenase injection/needle entry site, ICH lesion)

timing.protocol_description: LIPUS treatment was administered either as a single 5-min sonication session or as three 5-min sonication sessions with two 5-min rest intervals in between. The transducer was applied with a 2-ms burst length, a duty cycle of 20%, and a repetition frequency of 100 Hz ± 5%. LIPUS treatment (red dash) was performed daily from D0 to D2 in the brain, and mice were sacrificed on D3 (Experiment 2); a separate cohort received a 2-h-delayed LIPUS intervention after ICH to mimic clinical usage (Experiment 3).

exposures.label: LIPUS applied to glial/neuronal cell line and primary cultures (in vitro)

target.label: BV2 microglia, CTX TNA2 astrocytes, Neuro-2A neurons, and primary rat microglia/astrocyte cultures

timing.protocol_description: During the in vitro study, LIPUS was applied by sonication from the bottom of the culture plate to stimulate the cells. After thrombin/conditioned-media induction, BV2/TNA2/N2A cell-line cultures received 15-min LIPUS treatment and were measured at 24 h or 48 h; primary microglia/astrocyte cultures were stimulated with thrombin in the absence or presence of LIPUS treatment and harvested at 1, 3, or 24 h (durations for the primary-culture experiments are not separately restated). Ultrasound coupling gel was used between the transducer and the culture plate.

flags.reason: Paper states a study-wide total of 289 mice across sham/ICH/ICH+LIPUS arms and multiple sub-experiments with varying group sizes (e.g. n=7-9/group, n=8/group, n=7/group, n=6-8/group) but never gives a single total specific to LIPUS-exposed animals, so n_subjects is left not_reported.
Study combines in vivo mouse (animal) work with in vitro cell-line and primary rat culture (culture) work; subject_unit/n_sessions_per_subject given here reflect only the in vivo animal arm.

In vitro sonication parameters (burst length, duty cycle, PRF) are not explicitly restated for the cell-culture experiments; assumed but not confirmed to use the same ME740 apparatus settings as the in vivo work, so left not_reported.

The only in vitro intensity value given (ISPTA of 30 mW/cm2) is attributed to 'our previous study' as background safety context, not stated as the intensity actually used in this paper's in vitro experiments, so was not recorded as this exposure's value.
15-min duration explicitly stated only for the cell-line (BV2/TNA2/N2A) experiment; primary microglia/astrocyte culture experiments do not restate a duration.
